package: # DeviceGuard MDM bloatware list - Author: Sakthivel J

category: CAUTION = removable but you lose a feature
name: KEEP = needed by the system (danger)

package: # Packages not listed are treated as UNKNOWN (leave them alone). Overlays
category: providers and resources are always KEEP.

name: vivo Browser
note: Can get around Chrome rules - remove or hide

name: Browser (AOSP)
note: Old built-in browser - can get around Chrome rules

name: Jovi Smart Panel
note: Swipe-right panel on the home screen

name: Lock Screen Magazine
note: Lock screen wallpaper carousel with ads

name: UnionPay
note: Chinese payment service - unused in India

name: Live Wallpaper (Behavior)
note: Only needed if you use vivo live wallpapers

name: Live Wallpaper resources
note: Only needed if you use vivo live wallpapers

name: Live Wallpaper (Mountain)
note: Only needed if you use vivo live wallpapers

name: Live Wallpaper (Box)
note: Only needed if you use vivo live wallpapers

name: Live Wallpaper config
note: Only needed if you use vivo live wallpapers

name: YouTube
note: Video app (block or remove for kids)

name: Weather provider
note: Feeds weather to lock screen and widgets

name: Global Search
note: Swipe-down search on the home screen

name: EasyShare
note: Phone clone / transfer - useful after a reset

name: App Clone
note: Removing it disables App Clone (also helps Device Owner)

name: Private Space helper
note: Removing it disables vivo private space

name: Webcam mode
note: Use phone as a PC webcam

name: Google Restore
note: Needed to restore backups after a reset

name: vivo File Manager
note: File manager - keep at least one

name: vivo Account
column5: cloud and Find My Phone need it

name: Themes
note: Wallpapers & themes - removal can reset the look

name: Camera
note: Only camera app - keep unless you use another

name: Play Store
note: Control it from Apps & Play Store instead

name: Messages
note: Default SMS app - OTPs stop working

name: Gboard
note: Only keyboard - removing locks you out of typing
